story.titleZh: 阿斯顿·马丁F1车队巴西站周五计划完成
story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁F1车队在巴西大奖赛周五的测试计划顺利完成，需要分析数据并在夜间进行工作。

media.altZh: 阿斯顿·马丁F1车队巴西站周五计划完成 · 第 1 张

story.originalTitle: "We managed to get through our Friday plan and all of our running programme. We will need to look at the data now and have some work to do overnight."...
story.summaryEn:
"We managed to get through our Friday plan and all of our running programme. We will need to look at the data now and have some work to do overnight."
Debrief our Friday at the #BrazilGP: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-sao-paulo-gp
detailZh:
“我们成功完成了周五的计划和所有的测试程序。现在我们需要查看数据，并在夜间做一些工作。”
巴西大奖赛周五简报：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-sao-paulo-gp
detailEn:
"We managed to get through our Friday plan and all of our running programme. We will need to look at the data now and have some work to do overnight."
Debrief our Friday at the #BrazilGP: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-sao-paulo-gp
